n-k-k8-02.title: Whose words these be?
n-k-k8-02.topic: News: attribution and who stand behind a claim
n-k-k8-02.goal: Separate wetin news article report as somebody claim or prediction from wetin e count as data, and spot summary wey turn claim to fact.
n-k-k8-02.material:
Read this short (made-up) article.

□□시, 막차 1시간 늦춘다

□□시는 다음 달부터 시내버스 막차 시간을 1시간 늦춘다고 밝혔다. 시 관계자는 "이용객이 늘어난 노선부터 차례로 넓혀 갈 계획"이라고 설명했다. 지난해 밤 10시 이후 버스 이용객은 전년보다 12% 늘어난 것으로 집계됐다. 한 시민단체는 막차가 늦어지면 귀갓길 사고가 줄어들 것이라고 주장했다. 버스 노조는 운전기사가 부족해 계획대로 시행하기 어려울 것으로 보인다는 입장을 내놓았다.
n-k-k8-02.thinking.0: Who be source of each statement?
n-k-k8-02.thinking.3: Explaining the difference with words from the article
n-k-k8-02.prereq.1: Knows reporting verbs like 밝혔다, 주장했다, 설명했다
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.prompt: Choose ALL statements the article only pass along as somebody else opinion or prediction, without saying e true.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.hint.0: For every statement, ask: who talking, and e don happen already or na prediction?
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.hint.1: Check verbs ending sentences: some say ‘announced’ or ‘counted’; others say ‘argued’ or ‘position.’
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.r.a: City announcing its own bus decision; article report what city actually say.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.r.d: This report counted number, no be opinion or forecast.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.r.e: Na city official own plan; no outside forecast.
n-k-k8-02.s.s1.explain: Both b and c na forecast attributed to group (‘주장했다’, ‘어려울 것으로 보인다는 입장’). Article report dem say am; no confirm e go happen. a and e na city decision/plan; d na counted number.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.prompt: Classmate summarize article in 5 lines. Two lines turn somebody claim/forecast into fact. Choose one.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.hint.0: Underline speaker in each article sentence, then check every summary line keep am.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.hint.1: Find lines where forecast turn into statement about wetin happen or certain.
n-k-k8-02.s.s2.explain: Lines 3 and 5 wrong. Article say civic group argue accidents go decrease, and union only expect difficulty. Lines 3 and 5 remove who say am and present as fact. Lines 1, 2, 4 keep speaker.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.prompt: Another student write: ‘막차를 늦추면 사고가 줄어든다.’ In English or Korean, explain wetin wrong using article own words.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.hint.0: Find who in article actually say accidents go decrease.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.hint.1: Say what kind of statement e be (decision, count or something else) and wetin classmate sentence do to am.
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: I say na prediction/claim, no be something article confirm?
n-k-k8-02.s.s3.model.0: Article only say civic group argue (주장했다) accidents go decrease. Na their forecast, no be confirmed result, so sentence state am like fact.

n-k-k8-05.title: 9 o'clock plus two and half hours
n-k-k8-05.topic: time expressions: 정각, 반, 정오, 자정; schedule clash
n-k-k8-05.goal: Find 2 schedule lines wey no fit both true, correct dem, and judge whether notice show which one typo.
n-k-k8-05.material:
School send overnight retreat schedule to parents. Read as a whole.

수련회 일정 안내 (6월 14일)
※ 정각 = exactly on hour, 정오 = noon, 자정 = midnight.
n-k-k8-05.thinking.1: Read 정각, 반, 정오 and 자정
n-k-k8-05.thinking.3: Know wetin text alone cannot tell
n-k-k8-05.prereq.0: Fit read clock times like 11시 30분 and 두 시간 반
n-k-k8-05.s.s1.prompt: Two schedule lines no fit both true. Choose either.
n-k-k8-05.s.s1.hint.0: Check each line with start time and duration against end time stated.
n-k-k8-05.s.s1.hint.1: Pay attention to lines depending on earlier line.
n-k-k8-05.s.s1.explain: Lines 1 and 2 clash: leaving 9:00 and a 2-and-a-half-hour trip mean arrival 11:30, no be 11:00. Lines 3-6 dey agree (12:00 + 1 hour; 1:00 + 3 hours = 4:00; 6:00 + 1.5 hours = 7:30).
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.prompt: Rewrite ONE conflicting line in Korean (or write corrected time in English) so they match.
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.hint.0: Add travel duration to departure time and write result.
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.hint.1: You fit change arrival time, trip length or departure time, but all three must fit.
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Departure time, travel length and arrival time add up now?
n-k-k8-05.s.s2.modelNote.1: Fix travel length instead of arrival time.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.prompt: Classmate say: ‘Obviously arrival time typo.’ Safe conclusion from schedule alone?
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.hint.0: List 3 numbers wey must fit and ask which one text prove wrong.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.hint.1: Ask what extra info go make you sure.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.a: Yes: arrival time come last in chain, so na typo.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.r.a: Order of lines no show which number wrong; earlier number fit be typo too.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.b: Yes: parents go check arrival time, so school must make mistake.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.r.b: What parents check no show which number wrong.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.c: No: two lines already agree, nothing to fix.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.r.c: 9:00 plus 2 hours 30 minutes na 11:30, no match 11:00.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.o.d: No: any of three numbers fit be wrong, so school must confirm.
n-k-k8-05.s.s3.explain: Text only show three numbers (departure, trip length, arrival) no fit work together. Any one fit be wrong, so school must confirm which is fixed. Your fix reasonable guess, not proof.

n-k-k8-01.title: Who fit the limits in the notice?
n-k-k8-01.goal: Read number words in a formal volunteer notice, make several sign-ups wey meet all limits, and explain why one person on the boundary dey inside or outside.
n-k-k8-01.material:
One town post this notice. 만 N세 mean 'N years old by the Korean legal count'. Treat every number as whole number.

청소년 봉사단 '이웃' 참가자 모집 안내
1. 대상: 만 13세 이상, 만 18세 미만 청소년
2. 팀 구성: 한 팀은 3명 이상 5명 이하
3. 하루 활동 시간: 최소 1시간 이상, 4시간을 초과할 수 없음
4. 활동 일수: 5일 미만
5. 인증서: 총 활동 시간(하루 활동 시간 × 활동 일수)이 10시간 이상이어야 받을 수 있음
n-k-k8-01.thinking.0: Reading boundary words: the limit include the number itself?
n-k-k8-01.thinking.2: Finding more than one valid example
n-k-k8-01.prereq.0: Knows the pairs 이상/이하 (include the number) and 초과/미만 (no include am)
n-k-k8-01.prereq.1: Can read a numbered formal notice
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.prompt: Clause 3 say '4시간을 초과할 수 없음'. Participant fit work exactly 4 hours in one day?
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.hint.0: Say the clause with your own words: wetin forbidden, 4 hours or something else?
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.hint.1: Imagine person work exactly 4 hours and check if that break the clause.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.a: No: 초과 include the number itself, so exactly 4 hours banned.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.r.a: 초과 mean 'more than' and no include the number. Compare with 이상, wey include am.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.b: Yes: the limit na total hours, no be how many hours one day.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.r.b: Clause talk about 하루 (one day); total get separate limit for clause 5.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.c: Yes, but only for team with five members.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.r.c: Nothing for clause 3 depend on team size; team size dey for another clause.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.o.d: Yes: 4 hours na the limit; only more than 4 banned.
n-k-k8-01.s.s1.explain: 초과 mean 'more than' and leave out the number, so 4 hours allowed but 5 no. 이상/이하 include the number; 초과/미만 no.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.prompt: Fill ONE sign-up wey notice allow and wey earn certificate. Make 3 different sign-ups with 3 different ages. a = age (만 나이), n = team size, h = hours per day, d = number of days.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.hint.0: Change each numbered clause into short rule about one number before you choose values.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.hint.1: Start with age, then choose hours and days together, because clause 5 link dem.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.hint.2: Test a value at every edge (smallest and biggest number each clause seem to allow) and read the messages wey show.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Clause 3: at least 1 hour and no more than 4 hours per day.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.fail.c5: Clause 5: hours per day x days must be 10 or more.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.explain: Boundary values: age 13 allowed, 18 not allowed; teams with 3 or 5 both allowed; 4 hours per day allowed; 5 days not allowed; total exactly 10 hours enough. Plenty sign-ups fit because notice give limits, no be one exact plan.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Friend exactly 만 18세 today and wan join. In one or two sentences, Korean or English, tell your friend if dem fit join and why, using words from notice.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: First decide whether exactly 18 allowed, then name the clause word wey decide am.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Compare how 이상 and 미만 treat the number beside dem.
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: I clearly say 18 itself no allowed?
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: I use 미만 or explain wetin e leave out?
n-k-k8-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Dem no fit join. Notice say under 18 (미만), and 미만 no include 18 itself.
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.prompt: Staff member dey reply questions about same notice. Two lines read one boundary wrong. Choose one.
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.hint.0: For each line, find the matching clause and boundary word e use.
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.hint.1: For each line, ask: this boundary word count the number wey dey beside am?
n-k-k8-01.s.s3.explain: Lines 2 and 5 wrong. '5명 이하' include 5, so team with 5 allowed. '10시간 이상' include 10, so exactly 10 hours earn the certificate. Lines 1, 3, 4 read the boundary correct.

n-k-k8-03.title: Test classmate grammar note
n-k-k8-03.goal: Test classmate grammar rule with examples, decide how to correct am, and write your own counterexample sentence.
n-k-k8-03.material:
Classmate write am for notebook:

규칙: -(으)ㄴ/는데 = ‘but’. 앞의 내용과 뒤의 내용이 서로 반대일 때 쓴다.

Classmate ask: ‘My rule always correct?’ Test am.
n-k-k8-03.thinking.2: Revise rule instead of keeping am unchanged
n-k-k8-03.prereq.1: Fit write simple Korean sentence past or present
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.prompt: Which sentence be counterexample: -(으)ㄴ/는데 correct but two parts no oppose each other?
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.hint.0: Read each sentence and try insert ‘but’ between parts: natural every time?
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ask whether second part surprising/opposite to first, or just next part of story.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.r.a: Here second part go against wetin ‘pretty’ make you expect, so sentence fit rule; no be counterexample.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.r.b: Second part surprising after first, so fit rule.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.r.d: Result go against effort, so fit rule.
n-k-k8-03.s.s1.explain: In c, first part only set scene (I went market), second say wetin I found. No opposing ideas.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.prompt: What best way to correct note?
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.hint.0: Decide whether to discard rule or limit how much it claim.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.hint.1: Check fix still explain contrast sentences and counterexample.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.a: Keep rule as is because most -는데 sentences show contrast.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.r.a: A rule saying ‘always’ fail with one clear counterexample, even if many others fit.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.b: Say -는데 often show contrast, but can also set scene for what follow.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.c: Say -는데 mostly set scene and contrast examples wrong.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.r.c: Contrast sentences normal Korean; rule too narrow but partly right.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.o.d: Say -는데 contrast in writing but no in speech.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.r.d: Nothing in examples depend on speech versus writing.
n-k-k8-03.s.s2.explain: Rule ‘only contrast’ break with one good counterexample. Correct version keep true part (contrast one use) and add missing use (set scene for next part).
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.prompt: Write your own Korean sentence with -(으)ㄴ/는데 where two parts no contrast. Add short note in English or Korean about how first part support second.
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.hint.0: Think of moment you set scene before asking/telling: where, when, what you saw.
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.hint.1: After writing, try put ‘but’ between your parts; if it sound wrong, you got counterexample.
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Would ‘but’ sound wrong between my two parts?
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: My note say what first part do (e.g. set scene or reason for asking)?
n-k-k8-03.s.s3.model.0: 내일 시간이 있는데 같이 영화 볼래요? (First part set situation, then invite.)

n-k-k8-04.title: Refund clause wey keep changing
n-k-k8-04.topic: terms and conditions: rule, exception, exception to exception
n-k-k8-04.goal: Change refund decision as ticket terms add clauses, apply dem to another customer, explain why answer change.
n-k-k8-04.material: Mina buy concert ticket 5 days ago. Concert in 10 days. She cannot go, so today she apply for refund. Ticket terms show one clause at a time.
n-k-k8-04.thinking.1: Rule, exception, and exception to exception
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.prompt: Read each clause in order and choose best answer to ‘What refund Mina fit get?’ using only clauses visible.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.hint.0: Use only clauses you can see; no guess wetin come next.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.hint.1: Each time compare Mina dates (purchase 5 days ago, concert in 10 days) with every clause shown.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Clause give rule with no exception yet. ‘No refund’ reasonable answer, though careful reader remember exceptions fit follow.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: This clause no offer any money back.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Clause no say anything about fee or refund.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Not sure yet; more clauses fit come.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Not sure yet; more clauses fit come.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Not sure yet; more clauses fit come.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: With this clause added, what refund Mina fit get?
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Mina apply 10 days before concert, earlier than ‘7일 전’, so clause ② seem allow refund less fee. But new clause fit still limit am.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Clause ② na exception (‘다만’) to ①, and Mina apply 10 days before concert, so e look like ② apply.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Dem remove 10% fee, so no be full refund.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: With all 3 clauses, what refund Mina fit get?
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Clause ③ add second condition to ②: request must be within 3 days of purchase. Mina buy 5 days ago, so ② no apply; clause ① decide: no refund.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: She buy ticket 5 days ago, more than 3, so ② no longer apply.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: No clause give full refund in her case.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: These 3 clauses settle Mina dates already. You fit say ‘subject to other terms,’ but answer follow from what you know.
n-k-k8-04.s.s1.reflect: First rule say no; exception turn it to yes minus fee; final clause limit exception again. Words 다만 and 제2항은 ... 경우에만 show these steps. Read all clauses before deciding.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.prompt: Apply same 3 clauses to Jun. He buy ticket yesterday. Concert in 4 days. He apply today. What refund he get?
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.hint.0: Check Jun against each condition one by one: purchase date and days left before concert.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.hint.1: Exception works only if all its conditions met.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.a: Refund less 10% fee, because he apply within 3 days.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.r.a: Clause ② get second condition: application must be at least 7 days before concert.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.b: No refund, because 7-day deadline in ② don pass.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.c: Full refund, because he buy ticket only yesterday.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.r.c: No clause give full refund for recent purchase.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.o.d: No refund, because ② only for tickets bought 3 or more days ago.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.r.d: Clause ③ say opposite: ② apply only within 3 days of purchase.
n-k-k8-04.s.s2.explain: Jun meet 3-day condition in ③, but ② also require application 7 days before concert, and only 4 days remain. So ② no apply, and ① say no refund.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.prompt: Mina ask: ‘Clause ② say I get refund, so why answer change?’ Explain in 2-3 sentences in English or Korean.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.hint.0: Find clause added last and explain extra condition e add.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.hint.1: Compare condition with how many days since Mina buy ticket.
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: I mention 3-day condition in clause ③?
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: I explain why Mina purchase date no meet it?
n-k-k8-04.s.s3.model.0: Clause ③ say clause ② apply only if apply within 3 days of purchase. Mina buy 5 days ago, so ② no apply and basic no-refund rule ① stand.
